applied.quote: The total duration comes down to your monthly draw, your net return after inflation, and whether you have supplemental income from pensions or Social Security.

applied.quote: Using flat withdrawals in today's dollars, we mapped scenarios from zero growth up to a 5% real annual return.
applied.replacement: Using flat withdrawals in today's dollars, we mapped scenarios from zero growth up to a 5% real annual return. Withdrawals are taken at the end of each month, and the annual real return is divided by 12.

applied.quote: All inputs are listed so a reader can reproduce each row in our linked calculators.

applied.quote: If you are comparing portfolio milestones, our guide on [how long will 2 million last in retirement](/guides/how-long-will-2-million-last-in-retirement/) shows the duration numbers for double this starting balance.

applied.quote: A calculator that holds nominal dollar withdrawals flat without inflation adjustments, such as standard nominal models, will show different survival timelines for identical dollar figures.

applied.quote: That four-point difference in real return more than doubles the lifespan of your savings.
applied.replacement: That four-point difference in real return more than doubles the lifespan of your savings. applied.quote: Retirement planning often begins with a target time horizon based on life expectancy. Standard age arithmetic shows that planning to age 90 requires 35 years of withdrawals for someone retiring at age 55, 30 years from age 60, and 25 years from age 65.

applied.quote: This analysis is not designed for individuals who must extract $5,000 or more each month exclusively from a $1,000,000 balance over a 30-year span, nor does it fit someone whose asset allocation delivers returns that fail to keep pace with inflation.
